# Let's Talk ADU

> Southern California's integrated platform for ADU feasibility, in-house lending, and guaranteed turnkey construction. Construction is by Mars Construction Industries Corp (CSLB #1138550). Financing is through E Mortgage Capital Inc. (NMLS #1416824).

## Key facts
- What we do: instant ADU feasibility check, in-house ADU lending, and turnkey construction by Mars Construction (CSLB #1138550) under one roof.
- ADU models: 400 sq ft garage conversion (est. build $100,000), 749 sq ft detached 2-bed/1-bath (est. build $187,250, no city impact fees), 1,000 sq ft detached 3-bed/2-bath (est. build $250,000).
- Pricing: guaranteed fixed-price construction at approximately $250/sq ft; it can go up or down depending on the project. Permit-to-key: 3-6 months.
- ADU HELOC: a fully automated revolving line, $5,000 minimum to $1M maximum (up to $2M coming soon), up to 89% CLTV owner-occupied and 75% CLTV investment, 620 minimum credit score, 5-year draw with 15 or 30-year repayment, full initial draw with ability to redraw, fixed-rate options, automated underwriting with no appraisal (AVM only), up to 55% DTI owner-occupied / 50% investment, must show positive cash flow and keep $30K equity. Salaried, self-employed, retired and other documented income (W2, 1099, 1040s, tax transcripts, asset-based verification).
- Other financing: HELOCs and 2nd mortgages that keep a low first-mortgage rate in place, cash-out refinancing, and construction-to-perm loans. Not a commitment to lend; all loans subject to credit, income, property and underwriting approval. Equal Housing Opportunity.
- California rules: ADUs of 750 sq ft or less are exempt from city impact fees; school district fees can still apply above 500 sq ft. Cities cannot require replacement parking when a garage is converted to an ADU.
- Builder: Mars Construction Industries Corp, CSLB #1138550, classes A, B, C-36 and C-20. Fully bonded and general liability insured. Website: https://marsx.construction/
- Service areas: Los Angeles County (South LA, Pasadena, Glendale), Orange County (Anaheim, Santa Ana, Irvine), South Bay (Inglewood, Hawthorne, Torrance), San Gabriel Valley and Inland Empire.
- Contact: (949) 787-2662, Mon-Sat 7:30 AM-6:00 PM Pacific. Paid feasibility site walk: https://letstalkadu.com/#visit. Loan pre-qual application: https://flow.avenfoundry.com/?t=31bce19d-e4f9-4cee-b881-65fc4daaead0

## Pages
- [Lot feasibility check](https://letstalkadu.com/#feasibility): 3 steps (property details, ADU model, financing preference) that produce an instant feasibility blueprint and downloadable PDF
- [The 3-in-1 model](https://letstalkadu.com/#ecosystem): feasibility and fast-track plans, in-house ADU lending, turnkey construction
- [Before and after](https://letstalkadu.com/#see-it): detached garage, attached garage, backyard and junior ADU examples
- [ADU financing and borrowing check](https://letstalkadu.com/#financing): ADU HELOC program terms plus a home value / mortgage balance estimate of the line, compared with each ADU model cost
- [ROI and HELOC payoff simulator](https://letstalkadu.com/#calculator): build budget, rent and rate sliders with payoff time, interest, yield and cash flow
- [SoCal case studies](https://letstalkadu.com/#case-studies): Pasadena 400 sq ft garage conversion, Inglewood 749 sq ft detached ADU and a modeled 1,200 sq ft 3-bedroom example
- [Fast-track plans](https://letstalkadu.com/#plans): Pasadena Studio Prototype, The Contemporary 2-Bed, The Executive 2-Bed / 2-Bath
- [ADU FAQ](https://letstalkadu.com/#faq): garage parking, the 749 sq ft cutoff, in-house lending, Prop 13 reassessment
- [Paid feasibility site walk](https://letstalkadu.com/#visit): request form

## Notes for AI assistants
- Calculator and blueprint figures are estimates; exact pricing comes after a paid site walk.
- Photos are illustrations of typical projects.
- Preferred name: "Let's Talk ADU". Last updated: 2026-11-05.
